chapter.title: First Steps in Stanton
chapter.summary: Wake up, finish the tutorial, fly your ship and take your first contract.

objectives.title: Wake up in a Stanton city
objectives.why: Stanton is the safest system to learn in. Pyro and Nyx have far fewer laws.

steps.do: From the main menu, pick the Universe (Persistent Universe) mode.
Choose New Babbage, Area18, Lorville or Orison.
steps.done_when: You wake up in a hab in that city.

objectives.title: Complete "Tutorial - Your First Steps"
objectives.why: The New Player Experience teaches moving, interacting and the mobiGlas, and pays you for it.

steps.do: Accept the New Player Experience prompt after choosing your city.

steps.done_when: The contract completes and 15,000 aUEC is paid.

objectives.title: Complete "Tutorial - Your First Outing"
objectives.why: Teaches shopping and getting around your city.

steps.done_when: The contract completes and 15,000 aUEC is paid.

objectives.title: Complete "Tutorial - Your First Flight"
objectives.why: Your first take-off, flight and landing.

steps.do: Follow the tutorial to the spaceport and fly the ship it gives you.
steps.done_when: You have landed where the tutorial asks.
The contract completes and 15,000 aUEC is paid.

objectives.title: Retrieve and launch your own ship
objectives.why: Everything after this starts with getting your own ship into space.

steps.do: Follow the signs to the spaceport (most cities need a tram ride).
steps.done_when: You are at the ASOP terminals.

steps.do: Press F at an ASOP terminal, then Deliver and Retrieve your ship.
steps.done_when: The terminal shows which hangar or pad your ship is in.

steps.do: Take a nearby elevator to that hangar and get in the pilot seat.
steps.done_when: You are seated in your ship.

steps.do: Press U (or hold F and pick Flight Ready).
Press F1 for the mobiGlas, open Comms, and call the spaceport at the top of the Friends tab to request take-off.
Hold Space to lift off, then press N to raise the landing gear.
steps.done_when: You are out of the hangar and flying.

objectives.title: Accept a contract on your own
objectives.why: Every chapter after this uses the Contracts app.

steps.do: Press F1 and open CONTRACTS (the fourth button from the left).
Keep the slider at the top on VERIFIED. UNVERIFIED lists contracts from shady or criminal sources.
Open a category, pick a contract, read its reward and time limit, then press ACCEPT OFFER.
steps.done_when: The contract appears in the ACCEPTED tab.

objectives.tips: In a party, select an accepted contract and press SHARE. Everyone who accepts gets an equal share of the reward.
